references.text: The principle of compensation for killed animals is established here, where the one who causes an animal's death must pay compensation to the owner.
Contains the basic lex talionis formula 'life for life' (נֶפֶשׁ תַּחַת נָפֶשׁ) which is also used in Leviticus 24:18 regarding compensation.
Repeats and confirms the principle from verse 18: whoever kills an animal must make restitution for it.
Describes liability for compensation when someone borrows an animal that is injured or dies.
Establishes the fundamental principle that God demands accountability for life, both from animals and humans.
